title: Cech transition functions glue local trivial line bundles
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with an open cover $X=\bigcup_a U_a$. Suppose each $U_a$ carries the trivial invertible module [def-sc-invertible-module] and for every pair $(a,b)$ a unit $g_{ab}\in\Gamma(U_a\cap U_b,\mathcal O_X^\times)$ is given with $g_{aa}=1$, $g_{ba}=g_{ab}^{-1}$, and $g_{ac}=g_{ab}g_{bc}$ on triple overlaps. Then there is an invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal L$ [def-sc-invertible-module], unique up to unique isomorphism compatible with the chosen trivializations, whose transition functions are the $g_{ab}$.

source.place: Sheaves Lemma 00AM (sheaves-lemma-glue-sheaves-structures), applied to the rank-one free O_X-modules on the U_a glued along multiplication by g_ab

proof.text: Take the local modules F_a = O_X.over U_a. Define multiplication by a section on the over-site using unitHomEquiv and the section obtained by restricting that section. Multiplication by g_ab and by its inverse compose to the identity, giving transitionIso g_ab. This is the local rank-one gluing datum.

source.place: Sheaves Lemma 00AM (sheaves-lemma-glue-sheaves-structures), applied to the rank-one free O_X-modules on the U_a glued along multiplication by g_ab

proof.text: At every W contained in U_a, U_b and U_c, apply Units.val to hcoc and use associativity of multiplication to prove the componentwise cocycle required by glue_sheaves_of_modules. That theorem requires no separate identity or inverse hypotheses; hid and hinv are redundant for unit-valued cocycles.

source.place: Sheaves Lemma 00AM (sheaves-lemma-glue-sheaves-structures), applied to the rank-one free O_X-modules on the U_a glued along multiplication by g_ab

proof.text: Apply the object-gluing clause of glue_sheaves_of_modules to F_a and transitionIso g_ab, obtaining L and psi_a : L.over U_a isomorphic to O_X.over U_a. Define e_a as the inverse component of psi_a at U_a applied to 1. Naturality identifies e_a restricted to W with psi_a.inv_W(1); componentwise bijectivity and linearity show these are free generators. Apply the overlap compatibility to e_a and cancel psi_b to obtain e_a = g_ab e_b on U_a intersect U_b.

source.place: Sheaves Lemma 00AM (sheaves-lemma-glue-sheaves-structures), applied to the rank-one free O_X-modules on the U_a glued along multiplication by g_ab

proof.text: Every point belongs to a cover member. Its free generator gives overIso, which is transported via overFunctorEquiv, overEquiv and restrictFunctorIsoPullback to the pullback trivialization required by IsInvertible. Thus L is invertible.

source.place: Sheaves Lemma 00AM (sheaves-lemma-glue-sheaves-structures), applied to the rank-one free O_X-modules on the U_a glued along multiplication by g_ab

proof.text: For another framed module L prime, restrict both transition equations to W. Injectivity of multiplication by the free generator e_b prime shows that any relation r e_a prime = t e_b prime forces r times the restriction of g_ab = t; the same relation then holds for e_a and e_b. Repeat with the roles reversed. The source library glueHom constructs maps in both directions; isGlueValue_glueHom_app shows that they preserve each frame. Maps equal on free frames have equal components on every smaller open by linearity and surjectivity; the locality clause of glue_sheaves_of_modules makes them globally equal. Apply this criterion to the two composites and to any other frame-preserving isomorphism, proving the inverse identities and unique isomorphism assertion.

proof_origin.place: Stacks Sheaves Lemmas 00AM and 04TN; implemented using glue_sheaves_of_modules for object descent and morphism locality, and the proved source FreeGenerator.lean glueHom construction for frame-preserving maps. Sources read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00AM and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/04TN.

lean.statement: theorem exists_invertible_of_cech_transition {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type v} (U : ι → X.Opens) (hcover : ⨆ a, U a = ⊤) (g : ∀ a b, Γ(X, U a ⊓ U b)ˣ) (hid : ∀ a, g a a = 1) (hinv : ∀ a b (W : X.Opens) (ha : W ≤ U a) (hb : W ≤ U b), Units.map (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_inf hb ha)).op).hom.toMonoidHom (g b a) = (Units.map (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_inf ha hb)).op).hom.toMonoidHom (g a b))⁻¹) (hcoc : ∀ a b c (W : X.Opens) (ha : W ≤ U a) (hb : W ≤ U b) (hc : W ≤ U c), Units.map (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_inf ha hc)).op).hom.toMonoidHom (g a c) = Units.map (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_inf ha hb)).op).hom.toMonoidHom (g a b) * Units.map (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_inf hb hc)).op).hom.toMonoidHom (g b c)) : ∃ (L : X.Modules) (e : ∀ a, Γ(L, U a)), L.IsInvertible ∧ (∀ a, IsFreeGenerator (e a)) ∧ (∀ a b, L.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_left).op (e a) = (g a b).val • L.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_right).op (e b)) ∧ ∀ (L' : X.Modules) (e' : ∀ a, Γ(L', U a)), (∀ a, IsFreeGenerator (e' a)) → (∀ a b, L'.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_left).op (e' a) = (g a b).val • L'.presheaf.map (homOfLE inf_le_right).op (e' b)) → ∃! f : L' ≅ L, ∀ a, f.hom.app (U a) (e' a) = e a
